definitions.explanation: An exam given to students who failed the original exam, providing another opportunity to pass.

examples.japanese: {再試験|さいしけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{再試験|さいしけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I failed the exam, so I have to take a retake.

examples.japanese: {再試験|さいしけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}しない→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もらえない→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: If I don't pass the retake exam, I won't get the credit.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again) + ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (exam). Specifically for students who took but failed the original exam.

FORMS:
Commonly shortened to {再試|さいし} in student speech.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {再試験|さいしけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to take a retake exam
- {再試験|さいしけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}する→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧: to pass the retake
- {再試験|さいしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧: eligible for a retake

USAGE:
Some institutions cap the maximum grade on a retake (e.g., {可|か} or C only). The retake is typically harder or covers more material.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{追試|ついし}→追試：09971_tsuishi⟧: make-up exam (for students who were absent, not who failed)
- ⟦{補講|ほこう}→補講：09973_hokou⟧: make-up class
- ⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧: academic credit
